{{Top|leg}}
A '''relaxi chair''' was a type of furniture. The isolation ward of the infirmary at the [[Jedi Academy (Ossus)|Jedi Academy]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Ossus/Legends|Ossus]] had several relaxi-chairs.<ref name="JK">''[[Dark Nest I: The Joiner King]]''</ref>

In [[35 ABY/Legends|35 ABY]],<ref name="TERC">''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]'' dates the events of ''[[Dark Nest I: The Joiner King]]'' to [[35 ABY/Legends|35 ABY]].</ref> [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Cilghal]] performed tests on four [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi]]: [[Tesar Sebatyne]], [[Tahiri Veila]], [[Tekli]], and [[Darth Caedus|Jacen Solo]]. They were all seated on relaxi-chairs while wearing [[scanning hood]]s, as Cilghal and the other Jedi Masters present observed their brain patterns.<ref name="JK" />
